Supreme Court Petition Filed Over Metro Station Closures

A contempt petition has been filed in the Supreme Court alleging violation of court orders regarding the closure of metro stations. Petitioner lawyer Shailendra Mani Tripathi claims that despite directives, some station gates remain shut, citing the GTB Nagar station as an example and offering video evidence. Chirag Paswan has also raised questions about the metro closures.
